spans.s:
mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं)
1 A piece, a part, a fragment, a portion.
2 A chapter, a section.
3 A term in an equation.
m. (-ण्डः)
A flaw in a jewel.
2 Treacle or molasses partially dried or candied.
n. (-ण्डं)
1 A sort of sugar cane.
2 Black salt.
E.
खडि to break, and घञ् affix, or खन to tear, affix ड, and न changed to ण.

m. (-कः)
1 Pared or clipped finger nails.
2 A part, a piece.
E.
खण्ड to tear, वुन् aff.

m. (-र्णः)
Sweet potatoe.

f. (-था)
A tale or story divided into sections.
E.
खण्ड a section, and कथा a story.

n. (-लु)
An esculent root, sweet potatoe: also खण्डकालुक. n. (-कं)
E.
खण्डक a portion, and आलु any esculent root.

n. (-व्यं)
A poem interspersed with prose.
E.
खण्ड, and काव्य a poem.

m. (-जः)
Treacle, molasses.
E.
खण्ड, and ज what is produced.

f. (-रा)
Shears, scissors.
E.
खण्ड a part, and धृ to have or hold, in the causal form.

n. (-नं)
1 Breaking, dividing, cutting, reducing to pieces.
2 Destroying, annihilating.
3 Refuting, (in argument.)
4 Rebellion, opposition.
E.
खण्ड to break, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Destructive, skilful in cutting or destroying.
E.
खण्डन, and रत engaged in.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Brittle, fragile.
2

Refutable.
4

Destructible, &c.
E.
खडि, and अनीयर् affix; also खण्ड्य, and खण्डितव्य.

m. (-त्रं)
A bundle of various leaves.
E.
खण्ड, and पत्र a leaf.

m. (-शुः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
खण्ड a part, and परशु a hatchet; cutting his foes to pieces.

m. (-र्शुः)
1 A name of

PARAŚURĀMA.
2
A name of Ś

IVA.
3

Rāhu, the personified ascending node.
5 A spreader of unguents, fragrant powders, &c.
5 A drug, commonly

Candāmalaki.
6

An elephant with a broken tusk.
E.
खण्ड a part, and पर्शु an axe; whose axe or arms cut every thing to pieces.

m. (-लः)
A confectioner, a seller of sweetmeats.
E.
खण्ड molasses, and पाल who cherishes.

m. (-यः)
Partial destruction of the universe, the destruction of the division of the terrestrial world.
E.
खण्ड, and प्रलय destruction.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Gibbous, not full or round.
n. (-लं)
A segment of a circle, part of a circle or an incomplete sphere.
E.
खण्ड, and मण्डल sphere.

m. (-कः)
Granulated sugar.
E.
खण्ड, and मोदक a sweetmeat.

n. (-णं)
Black salt.
E.
खण्ड, and लवण salt.

ind.
Piece-meal, in or by pieces.
E.
खण्ड, and शसि aff.

m. (-रः)
Granulated sugar.
E.
खण्ड, and सर what goes.

n. (-भ्रं)
1 Scattered clouds.
2 A bite, the impression of the teeth.
E.
खण्ड a part, and अभ्र a cloud, &c.

f. (-ली)
1 A measure for oil.
2 A pond.
3 A woman whose husband has been guilty of infidelity.

Pease.
2

The armpit.
E.
खडि to break, इकन् aff.

m. (-कः)
A confectioner, a seller of sweetmeats.
E.
खण्ड molasses or coarse sugar, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Cut, torn, broken in pieces.
2

Destroyed.
3

Broken as allegiance, disobeyed against, rebelled.
4 Refuted, controverted.
5 Scattered, dispersed.
6

Disappointed.
7

Betrayed, abandoned, (as a lover.)
f. (-ता)
A woman whose husband or lover has been guilty of infidelity.
E.
खडि to cut, affix क्त.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be broken, what may or ought to be broken, confuted, destroyed, &c.
E.
खडि, and तव्य aff.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Maimed, mutilated.
E.
खण्डित, and विग्रह body.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Disappointed, foiled, frustrated.
E.
खण्डित, and आशंसा expectation.

mfn. (-ण्डी-ण्डिनी-ण्डि)
1 In pieces or parts, divided, comminuted, &c.
2 Consisting of pieces or parts.
m. (-ण्ड)
A wild [] kind of kidney bean: see वनमद्ग.
f. (-नी)
The earth.
E.
खण्ड a portion, and इनि aff.

m. (-रः)
A kind of kidney bean: see पीतमुद्ग.
E.
खण्ड a part, ईरन् aff.

mfn. (ण्ड्यः-ण्ड्या-ण्ड्यं)
What may or ought to be broken, &c. see खण्डितव्य.
E.
खडि, and यत् aff.

n. (-वं)
A wood, sacred to INDRA.
